title: Spain Basque Country Crop fields
description: Official agricultural field boundaries for Spain's Basque Country (Euskadi), sourced from the SIGPAC geographic information system used for EU agricultural subsidy applications. The dataset contains 562,407 parcels with crop type codes and administrative codes, converted to fiboa GeoParquet format from 2024 campaign data.
readme:
## README.md
# Field boundaries for Spain Basque Country

Provides 562407 official field boundaries from Spain Basque Country.
It has been converted to a fiboa GeoParquet file from data obtained from Basque Government.

- **Source Data Provider:** [Basque Government](https://www.euskadi.eus/gobierno-vasco/inicio/)
- **Converted by:** Ivor Bosloper
- **License:** CC-BY
- **Projection:** EPSG:25830

---

- [Download the data as fiboa GeoParquet](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-pv/es_pv.parquet)
- [STAC Browser](https://radiantearth.github.io/stac-browser/#/external/data.source.coop/fiboa/es-pv/stac/collection.json)
- [STAC Collection](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-pv/stac/collection.json)
- [PMTiles](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-pv/es_pv.pmtiles)

## Columns

| Property               | **Data Type** | Description |
|------------------------|---------------|-------------|
| id                     | string        |             |
| determination_datetime | timestamp     |             |
| crop:code              | string        |             |
| crop:name              | string        |             |
| admin:country_code     | string        |             |
| crop:code_list         | string        |             |
| admin:subdivision_code | string        |             |
